intro: Perched high on the northern bluffs above Marshal's Refuge, the Shaper's Terrace is a mysterious overlook marked by ancient titan architecture. It is named in honor of Khaz'goroth the Shaper and bears quiet witness to the primordial experiments that shaped Un'Goro Crater.

p: Overlooking the lush, prehistoric basin of Un'Goro Crater, the Shaper's Terrace holds monumental stone edifices left behind by the titans. Believed to be dedicated to Khaz'goroth the Shaper, this high plateau stands as a testament to the celestial architects who cultivated the crater as a living laboratory for early life on Azeroth. From these elevated stones, ancient entities once observed and directed the flora and fauna below. Its cold stone arches and massive metallic plinths stand in stark, enigmatic contrast to the untamed wilderness thriving directly beneath them.
